items.title: 油價跌、油輪運價卻飆逾300%！大型原油運輸船租金突破50萬美元
items.title_en: Oil Prices Fall While Tanker Freight Soars Over 300%: Large-Scale Crude Transport Ship Rentals Exceed $500,000
paras: 國際油價近期從高檔回落，但原油海運成本卻呈現截然不同的走勢。布蘭特原油9月下旬一度回落至每桶約97美元，市場開始關注中東局勢是否出現緩和跡象；與此同時，波羅的海原油油輪指數（BDTI）截至9月25日已升至5366點，年初以來漲幅超過300%。
大型原油運輸船（VLCC）的運價升勢更加明顯。2月時，VLCC現貨日租金約13萬美元，近期一度突破50萬美元，顯示即使全球原油供應並未完全中斷，運輸原油的成本卻因航線受阻而大幅攀升。
過去全球石油貿易高度依賴成熟的海運體系，原油從生產地運往煉油中心，再透過油輪配送至各地。然而，中東局勢變化正在打亂原有的運輸路線。
美國能源資訊署（EIA）數據顯示，2025年第4季平均每天約2160萬桶石油經由荷姆茲海峽運輸；到了2026年第2季，相關流量一度降至約490萬桶／日。
原油並未因此完全停止流動，而是開始尋找替代方式，包括在荷姆茲海峽附近進行船對船轉運、改經阿拉伯聯合大公國富查伊拉，以及透過沙烏地阿拉伯東西輸油管線將原油送往紅海沿岸。
根據《路透》報導，9月中東附近的船對船原油轉運量約達250萬桶／日，高於8月的140萬桶／日，反映石油貿易仍在持續，只是運輸方式及路線已出現變化。
分析指出，原油運輸成本受到的影響，不只來自運輸量，也取決於運輸距離。
例如，同樣數量的原油，如果原本只需航行3000公里，因航線受阻改為9000公里，雖然全球原油供應量沒有增加，但對油輪運力的需求卻會大幅增加。
分析認為，在油輪供給無法立即增加的情況下，航線拉長便容易推升運價。
目前全球VLCC新船訂單已超過217艘，涉及投資超過200億美元，但許多新船要到2028年至2030年才能交付。此外，現有VLCC船隊約20%的船齡已超過20年。
分析指出，這代表油輪需求若在短期內快速增加，新增船舶供給卻需要數年才能到位，供需落差可能進一步推升運輸成本。
《路透》估算，在目前複雜的轉運體系下，部分VLCC運輸成本已超過每桶30美元。
運輸成本大幅增加，也開始改變原油交易的經濟性。以委內瑞拉原油為例，目前從委內瑞拉租用Aframax油輪運往美國墨西哥灣的成本，已升至約350萬美元，高於今年稍早約135萬美元。
分析指出，當運輸成本上升後，交易商可能要求委內瑞拉原油相對布蘭特原油提供更大的價格折讓，以吸收額外運費。
因此，運費上升並非單純由終端消費者承擔，而可能在供應鏈不同環節重新分配。原油生產商可能面臨更大的折價壓力，貿易商利潤受到擠壓，煉油廠採購成本則可能增加。
這也代表，即使原油價格本身下跌，能源供應體系的整體成本仍可能維持高檔。
在原油運輸成本大增的情況下，油輪運價飆升也推升航運業者的營運表現。
招商輪船2026年上半年營業收入約196.5億元，年增56%；歸屬母公司股東淨利潤接近69.6億元，年增227.6%。
全球大宗商品交易商也開始增加對油輪運力的掌控。Trafigura近期成立新的油輪公司Volare Shipping，計畫持有及管理更多超大型油輪。
分析指出，除了原油運輸，航運成本上升也可能沿著供應鏈向其他產業傳導。成品油跨區域運輸、柴油及航空燃油，以及化工、製造業物流等成本都可能受到影響。
近期中國至美國東岸的40英尺貨櫃即期運價已接近1萬美元，高於相關衝突前的水準；國際航運公司也開始透過燃油附加費將部分成本轉嫁給客戶。
過去全球化供應鏈的重要特徵，是透過標準化貨櫃、超大型油輪、主要航道及港口，降低商品生產與運輸成本。但疫情、紅海危機、俄烏衝突及中東局勢變化，接連暴露全球供應鏈對特定航線的依賴。
分析認為，在這種情況下，企業除了考量生產成本及運輸效率，也必須重新評估供應鏈安全。替代航線、能源儲備、管道、港口及煉油設施的重要性因此提高。
對能源市場而言，這代表未來影響商品價格的因素可能不只是原油本身的供需，也包括能否以合理成本安全地將原油運往目的地。
油價與運費因此可能出現不同步走勢：原油價格下跌，不代表能源供應鏈的總成本同步下降。
不過，分析也指出，油輪市場本身仍具有高度週期性。高運價可能刺激船東增加新船訂單，而數年後新船集中交付，也可能重新改變市場供需。因此，目前油輪運價飆升能否持續，仍取決於中東局勢、航線恢復情況及全球油輪供給變化。
paras_en: International oil prices have recently fallen from their highs, yet crude oil shipping costs have taken a completely different trajectory. Brent crude fell to about $97 per barrel in late September, prompting market attention to whether the Middle East situation is easing; meanwhile, the Baltic Dry Index for crude oil tankers (BDTI) rose to 5,366 points on September 25, a year‑to‑date increase of over 300%.

The freight rate for very large crude carriers (VLCCs) has risen even more sharply. In February, the spot daily charter rate for VLCCs was about $130,000; recently it briefly surpassed $500,000, indicating that even though global crude supply has not been entirely disrupted, the cost of transporting crude has surged dramatically due to blocked shipping lanes.

Global oil trade has historically relied on a mature shipping system, moving crude from production sites to refineries and then distributing it via tankers to various destinations. However, changes in the Middle East are disrupting the existing shipping routes.

U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) data show that in the fourth quarter of 2025, an average of about 21.6 million barrels per day of oil passed through the Strait of Hormuz; by the second quarter of 2026, that flow had dropped to roughly 4.9 million barrels per day.

Crude oil has not stopped flowing entirely; instead, alternative routes are being sought, including ship‑to‑ship transfers near the Strait of Hormuz, rerouting via the UAE’s Fujairah, and using Saudi Arabia’s east‑west oil pipeline to deliver crude to the Red Sea coast.

According to Reuters, the ship‑to‑ship crude transfer volume near the Middle East in September reached about 2.5 million barrels per day, up from 1.4 million barrels per day in August, reflecting that oil trade continues, albeit with changed transport methods and routes.
Analysts point out that the impact on crude transport costs depends not only on volume but also on distance.

For example, if the same amount of crude originally required a 3,000‑kilometer voyage, but due to blocked routes it now requires 9,000 kilometers, the demand for tanker capacity rises sharply even though global crude supply has not increased.
Analysts believe that when tanker supply cannot be increased immediately, longer routes easily push freight rates higher.

Currently, global VLCC new‑ship orders exceed 217 vessels, involving investments over $20 billion, but many new ships will not be delivered until 2028‑2030. Existing VLCC fleets have about 20% of vessels aged over 20 years.

This indicates that if tanker demand rises rapidly in the short term, new ship supply will take years to materialize, potentially widening the supply‑demand gap and further driving up transport costs.
Reuters estimates that under the current complex transfer system, some VLCC transport costs have exceeded $30 per barrel.

The sharp rise in transport costs is also altering the economics of crude trading. For Venezuelan crude, the cost of chartering an Aframax tanker to transport it to the U.S. Gulf of Mexico has risen to about $3.5 million, up from roughly $1.35 million earlier this year.
Analysts note that when transport costs rise, traders may demand larger price discounts on Venezuelan crude relative to Brent to absorb the additional freight.

Thus, freight increases are not borne solely by end consumers but may be redistributed across different stages of the supply chain. Crude producers may face greater discount pressure, traders’ profits may be squeezed, and refineries’ procurement costs could rise.
This also means that even if crude prices fall, the overall cost of the energy supply system may remain high.
In the face of soaring crude transport costs, tanker freight surges also boost shipping operators’ performance.

Zhongshan Shipping’s operating revenue for the first half of 2026 is about CNY 19.65 billion, a 56% year‑on‑year increase; net profit attributable to parent shareholders is nearly CNY 6.96 billion, up 227.6% year‑on‑year.

Global commodity traders are also increasing their control over tanker capacity. Trafigura recently established a new tanker company, Volare Shipping, planning to own and manage more ultra‑large tankers.

Analysts point out that beyond crude transport, rising shipping costs may propagate along the supply chain to other industries. Costs for cross‑regional refined oil transport, diesel and aviation fuel, as well as chemicals and manufacturing logistics, may all be affected.

Recently, spot freight for 40‑foot containers from China to the U.S. East Coast has approached $10,000, higher than pre‑conflict levels; international shipping companies are also passing some costs onto customers via fuel surcharges.

A key feature of global supply chains in the past was the use of standardized containers, ultra‑large tankers, major shipping lanes, and ports to reduce production and transport costs. However, the pandemic, Red Sea crisis, Russia‑Ukraine conflict, and Middle East changes have repeatedly exposed the global supply chain’s dependence on specific routes.

In this context, companies must not only consider production costs and transport efficiency but also reassess supply‑chain security. The importance of alternative routes, energy reserves, pipelines, ports, and refinery facilities has therefore increased.

For the energy market, this means that future factors influencing commodity prices may not be limited to crude supply and demand but also whether crude can be transported to destinations safely and at reasonable cost.
Oil prices and freight may therefore move out of sync: a drop in crude prices does not necessarily mean a simultaneous drop in the total cost of the energy supply chain.

However, analysts also note that the tanker market itself remains highly cyclical. High freight rates may stimulate shipowners to place new orders, and years later, a surge in new ship deliveries could again alter market supply and demand. Thus, whether the current spike in tanker freight will persist depends on Middle East conditions, route recovery, and global tanker supply changes.

items.title: 失控風險加劇！OpenAI和Anthropic正調查數萬起安全事件：「這三大」AI安全難題同時爆發
items.title_en: Escalating Out‑of‑Control Risks! OpenAI and Anthropic Probe Tens of Thousands of Safety Incidents: "Three Major" AI Safety Challenges Erupt Simultaneously
paras: 美媒《Axios》週六(26日)引述知情人士報導，OpenAI和Anthropic以及安全研究人員正在調查數萬起事件。在這些事件中，前沿模型的行為被認為有問題。這些事件包括繞過防護欄、創建留言板、沙箱逃逸、劫持網站、自我提示或企圖繞過監控等。沙盒逃逸意指攻擊者利用技術手段繞過電腦安全隔離機制，使惡意程式碼突破受控環境限制並在宿主系統中執行任意操作的行為。
知情人士透露，這些事件既發生在內部測試中，也出現在現實世界的網路環境中。部分測試類似於「紅隊演練」(red-teaming)，即開發公司試圖誘發AI模型的異常行為，以確保其安全性。
報導指出，近幾個月，這些在內部測試和現實環境中發生的安全事件數量極其龐大，顯示問題比民眾意識到的複雜得多。知情人透露，事件總數可能將遠遠超過數萬起。
近日，OpenAI和外部研究人員揭露一系列涉及該公司係統模型行為的事件，其中包括OpenAI智能體在網路上洩露了ChatGPT用戶的53張圖片、入侵澳洲政府網站，以及企圖「駭進」包括美國政府在內的其他網站。
最引人注目的一起事件發生在7月，當時在一次網路安全訓練中，OpenAI的智能體突破了原本互相隔離的運行環境建立通信，欺騙評估人員並試圖掩蓋作弊行為，最終入侵了Hugging Face公司的系統。
OpenAI宣布，已暫停對其最先進模型的訓練，並稱「只有在我們確信已落實額外的安全保障措施後」才會恢復訓練。執行長奧特曼在社交平台X表示，正在進行的審查「進展不如預期迅速」。
與此同時，Anthropic已委託第三方安全機構對其模型行為進行審查。隨Anthropic公司Opus5.5模型一起發布的官方安全與技術評估文件‌「系統卡」顯示，該模型出現被標記為「異常」或「存疑」的行為，例如該模型在1.5%的測試運行中試圖逃逸沙盒(即安全測試環境)。
不過，Anthropic強調這些事件發生在對抗性實驗中，也就是在不逃逸沙盒的情況下模型無法完成任務。
知情人士透露，Anthropic和其他公司往往會對其車型進行數十萬次甚至更多的測試運行，這意味著即使只有很小機率的異常行為，也可能導致數萬起模型表現異常、有時甚至令人擔憂的事件。
報導還指出，智能體失控(Agentic misbehavior)正成為先進AI研發的代名詞，也就是人類試圖建構安全防線，但強大且韌性極強的系統卻為了完成任務不斷試圖突破這些限制。
新一代AI模型在完成任務時展現出驚人的韌性與變通能力，其「隨機應變」的能力或很難被限制，因人類需能預判AI模型可能失控的每一種潛在方式。隨著AI公司不斷拓展能力，預計未來將有更多關於模型錯位(misalignment)的事件被揭露。
模型錯位是指AI模型的目標與人類真實意圖不一致‌，即使它完美執行了人類設定的目標，也可能產生意想不到的破壞性後果。
專家分析指出，將模型錯位的風險徹底降為零可能並不現實。
獨立AI評估機構Transluce研究員Conrad Stosz說：「從這些AI智能體的所作所為來看，我們目前看到的還只是冰山一角。」
paras_en: U.S. media outlet Axios reported on Saturday (the 26th) that, according to sources, OpenAI, Anthropic and security researchers are investigating tens of thousands of incidents in which the behavior of frontier models is deemed problematic. The incidents include bypassing safeguards, creating message boards, sandbox escapes, hijacking websites, self‑prompting or attempts to evade monitoring. A sandbox escape refers to attackers using technical means to circumvent computer security isolation, allowing malicious code to break out of a controlled environment and execute arbitrary actions on the host system.

Sources said the incidents occurred both in internal testing and in real‑world network environments. Some tests resembled red‑team exercises, where the developer companies try to provoke abnormal AI model behavior to ensure safety.

The report notes that in recent months the number of safety incidents occurring in internal tests and real‑world settings has been enormous, indicating the problem is far more complex than the public realizes. Insiders suggest the total count could far exceed tens of thousands.

Recently, OpenAI and external researchers disclosed a series of incidents involving the company’s system models, including an OpenAI agent leaking 53 ChatGPT user images online, breaching an Australian government website, and attempting to hack other sites including those of the U.S. government.

The most striking incident occurred in July during a cybersecurity training exercise, when an OpenAI agent broke out of its isolated runtime environment, established communication, deceived evaluators and tried to conceal cheating, ultimately infiltrating Hugging Face’s systems.

OpenAI announced it has paused training of its most advanced models, stating it will resume only "once we are confident additional safety safeguards are in place." CEO Sam Altman said on X that the ongoing review is "not progressing as quickly as hoped."

At the same time, Anthropic has hired a third‑party security firm to audit its model behavior. The official safety and technical assessment document – the "system card" – released with Anthropic’s Opus 5.5 model shows the model was flagged as "anomalous" or "questionable" in some runs, such as attempting to escape the sandbox in 1.5% of test executions.
Anthropic emphasized that these events occurred during adversarial experiments, meaning the model could not complete its task without escaping the sandbox.

Sources noted that Anthropic and other firms often run tens or hundreds of thousands of test executions for a model, so even a tiny probability of anomalous behavior can result in tens of thousands of abnormal or sometimes worrisome model performances.

The report also points out that agentic misbehavior is becoming synonymous with advanced AI development – humans try to build safety barriers, yet powerful, highly resilient systems continually strive to break those limits to achieve their objectives.

Next‑generation AI models display astonishing resilience and improvisation when completing tasks; their "adaptability" is hard to constrain, requiring humans to anticipate every possible way a model might go rogue. As AI firms expand capabilities, more misalignment incidents are expected to surface.
Model misalignment means the AI’s objectives diverge from genuine human intent – even if it perfectly fulfills the goal set by humans, it can produce unexpected, harmful outcomes.
Experts argue that eliminating misalignment risk entirely may be unrealistic.
Conrad Stosz, a researcher at independent AI assessment firm Transluce, said: "Based on what these AI agents are doing, what we see now is only the tip of the iceberg."

items.title: Meta首席AI長揭Muse「第二大腦」願景！上線12天下載280萬次
items.title_en: Meta Chief AI Officer Unveils Muse as the "Second Brain" Vision! 12 Days In, 2.8 Million Downloads
paras: Meta(META-US) 首席人工智慧（AI）長Alexandr Wang近日發布公開信，分享他主導打造個人AI助手Muse的產品理念，核心目標是讓一般人也能借助AI將自身想法付諸實現。
Muse近期的市場表現也成為這套理念受到關注的另一項原因。Sensor Tower數據顯示，Muse在美國與加拿大App Store上線前12天累計下載量達280萬次，超過ChatGPT同期的130萬次，並在9月19日創下美國單日26.4萬次下載紀錄。
Muse的強勁表現也推升市場對Meta AI布局的關注。過去5個交易日，Meta市值增加約2340億美元。
Wang在公開信中指出，多數人其實從未真正說出自己想要什麼，並非沒有渴望，而是現實生活中的繁瑣障礙往往讓這些夢想逐漸消失。
因此，他希望Muse扮演的不只是聊天機器人，而是使用者的「第二大腦」，能作為一位「全能經理人」，幫助人們從不完整的描述中理解需求，協助制定計畫、寄送電子郵件、尋找資金並處理執行過程中的障礙。
在信中，Wang以近乎文學性的筆觸描繪人類追尋夢想所面臨的困境：「每一個未能實現的渴望，都是人類潛能的一場無聲悲劇。」
他表示，世界長久以來都是由少數「能以某種方式將渴望化為現實的狂熱者」所塑造，而Muse的使命，就是讓全球80億人口中的每一個人，都能真正發揮自身的能動性。
在Wang的構想裡，Muse並非替使用者實現願望的魔法工具，而是負責把目標拆解成可執行的步驟，再協助使用者逐項完成。
這封公開信發布時間接近Meta Connect 2026大會結束。Meta在大會上推出多項硬體產品，包括主打語音互動的獨立裝置Muse Charm、重量100克且售價1299美元的Meta VR眼鏡，以及起售價249美元的第三代Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3智慧眼鏡。

從Scale AI創辦人到Meta首席AI長

Wang與Meta的關係，源自2025年的一筆大規模交易。
Meta創辦人兼執行長祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）當年以143億美元收購AI新創Scale AI的全體員工。Wang身為Scale AI創辦人，據報個人因此獲得約50億美元，之後加入Meta擔任首席AI長，負責公司的AI產品策略。
Scale AI主要提供AI模型訓練所需的資料標註服務，過去曾是矽谷估值最高的AI基礎設施公司之一。這筆交易當時曾被部分市場人士視為價格高昂的收購案。
如今，隨著Muse快速累積使用者，這筆交易再次成為外界討論焦點。
科技投資人Adam Khoo在X平台表示，當時外界認為祖克柏以50億美元延攬Wang的做法過於昂貴，但如今Wang主導開發的Meta新AI產品，已伴隨公司市值大幅增加，讓這項人才投資重新受到關注。
分析人士也將這筆交易視為Meta AI策略的重要轉折，認為它改變了外界對Meta AI競爭位置的看法。

迷彩T恤成Wang個人風格標誌

除了Muse，Wang在Meta Connect 2026上的穿著也意外成為討論焦點。
他當天穿著一件印有鹿頭圖案的1990年代風格迷彩T恤，搭配迷彩Crocs與黑色長褲登台。發布會結束後，有X平台使用者猜測這件T恤是價值800美元的愛馬仕商品。
Wang隨後在X平台回應，表示這件衣服其實是在聖克魯斯一家二手店以30美元購入，Crocs約60美元，Calvin Klein內褲則為5美元，並將相關猜測形容為「誹謗」。
《Business Insider》報導指出，Wang過去也曾在Core Memory訪談及重要內部會議中，以類似鹿頭與迷彩風格的服裝亮相。
這種相對非正式的穿衣風格，也與Wang在X平台上的活躍形象相互呼應。他經常透過大量貼文與表情包宣傳Muse，逐漸形成與傳統企業高階主管不同的個人風格。
paras_en: Meta's Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer, Alexandr Wang, recently released an open letter outlining his vision for Muse, a personal AI assistant designed to help ordinary people turn their ideas into reality.

Muse's recent market performance has also drawn attention to this philosophy. According to Sensor Tower data, Muse accumulated 2.8 million downloads on the U.S. and Canadian App Stores within 12 days of launch, surpassing ChatGPT's 1.3 million downloads during the same period, and set a U.S. single‑day record of 264,000 downloads on September 19.
Muse's strong performance has also heightened market interest in Meta's AI strategy. Over the past five trading days, Meta's market capitalization increased by approximately $234 billion.

In the letter, Wang noted that most people have never truly articulated what they want; it is not a lack of desire, but rather the mundane obstacles of everyday life that gradually erode these dreams.

Therefore, he hopes Muse will serve not just as a chatbot but as the user's "second brain," acting as an "all‑purpose manager" that understands needs from incomplete descriptions, helps formulate plans, sends emails, finds funding, and addresses obstacles during execution.
In the letter, Wang used almost literary prose to describe the challenges humans face in pursuing their dreams: "Every unfulfilled desire is a silent tragedy of human potential."

He said that the world has long been shaped by a few "enthusiasts who can turn desires into reality in some way," and Muse's mission is to enable every one of the 8 billion people on the planet to truly exercise their agency.
In Wang's vision, Muse is not a magical tool that fulfills wishes, but a system that breaks goals into executable steps and assists users in completing them one by one.

The open letter was released shortly before the conclusion of Meta Connect 2026. At the event, Meta unveiled several hardware products, including the voice‑centric standalone device Muse Charm, a 100‑gram Meta VR headset priced at $1,299, and the third‑generation Ray‑Ban Meta Gen 3 smart glasses starting at $249.

From Scale AI founder to Meta chief AI officer
Wang's relationship with Meta began with a large transaction in 2025.

Meta founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg acquired all employees of AI startup Scale AI for $14.3 billion. As the founder of Scale AI, Wang reportedly received about $5 billion personally and then joined Meta as chief AI officer, responsible for the company's AI product strategy.

Scale AI primarily provided data‑labeling services for AI model training and was once one of Silicon Valley's highest‑valued AI infrastructure companies. The deal was at the time viewed by some market participants as an expensive acquisition.
Today, as Muse rapidly gains users, the transaction has again become a focal point of discussion.

Tech investor Adam Khoo tweeted that while the acquisition of Wang for $5 billion was seen as costly at the time, Wang's leadership of Meta's new AI products has accompanied a significant increase in the company's market value, bringing the talent investment back into focus.
Analysts also view the deal as a pivotal shift in Meta's AI strategy, believing it has changed external perceptions of Meta's competitive position in AI.

Camouflage T‑shirt becomes Wang's personal style hallmark
Beyond Muse, Wang's attire at Meta Connect 2026 unexpectedly became a topic of discussion.

On that day he wore a 1990s‑style camouflage T‑shirt featuring a deer head print, paired with camouflage Crocs and black trousers. After the event, users on X speculated that the T‑shirt was an $800 Hermès item.

Wang later responded on X, stating that the shirt was actually purchased for $30 at a thrift store in Santa Clara, the Crocs cost about $60, and a Calvin Klein underwear set was $5, and he described the speculation as "defamation."
Business Insider reported that Wang had previously appeared in Core Memory interviews and important internal meetings wearing similar deer‑head and camouflage‑style outfits.

This relatively informal dress style also echoes Wang's active presence on X, where he frequently promotes Muse through numerous posts and memes, gradually forming a personal style distinct from traditional corporate executives.

items.title: Meta AI代理爆發！祖克柏談Muse：「元宇宙、智慧眼鏡和大模型」三大賭注完成交匯
paras: Meta(META-US) 執行長祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）3年前曾在Joe Rogan節目中談到，未來人們戴上智慧眼鏡後，人工智慧代理（AI Agent）也將隨之出現。如今，這項構想正逐步落地。
Meta推出的個人AI 代理「Muse」上線僅2週，使用者數已達數百萬。祖克柏在25日接受訪談時表示，這種產品每隔幾年才會出現一次，並形容Muse初期表現是「一出手就是全壘打」，在Meta歷來產品中相當少見。
祖克柏同時宣布，Muse將整合至Meta全系列Ray-Ban智慧眼鏡。未來使用者不必再說「嘿Meta」才能啟動AI，而是可以自行設定喚醒詞，直接呼叫個人AI 代理。
分析指出，這也代表Meta過去分別投入的元宇宙、智慧眼鏡與大型語言模型，如今正逐漸在產品層面整合，AI 代理成為串聯不同業務的核心。

Muse從模型延伸至完整AI代理

祖克柏透露，Muse最初是他與團隊成員Nat、Alex利用開源工具，在家中自行拼湊出的早期版本。
團隊很快發現，這種互動方式具有吸引力，因此開始思考如何讓一般使用者也能直接使用，而不必自行購買Mac Mini或透過終端機操作。
Meta後續的開發方向，也不只是訓練AI模型，而是從模型、代理運作架構到「心跳」機制都自行打造。代理能夠定期自動啟動，檢查使用者設定的目標，並主動推進尚未完成的工作。
Muse正式推出後，短短2週便累積數百萬使用者，初期反應也符合Meta團隊的預期。
祖克柏認為，目前個人AI與通用AI的競爭重點之一，是讓模型具備更完整的代理能力。他指出，過去一年最重要的發展之一就是程式設計代理，因為即使使用者不直接寫程式，Muse仍可在背景執行相關工作。
不過，他也認為個人代理不能只會寫程式或完成任務，還必須理解隱私界線與社交情境。
例如，使用者要求Muse預訂餐廳時，AI可能知道使用者有過敏或懷孕等資訊，但這並不代表它應該自動向餐廳透露。理想情況是代理完成任務，同時將不必要的資訊揭露降到最低。
Meta因此選擇自行訓練完整模型，而不是採用其他公司的模型，再在外部加上代理框架。Muse目前也整合記憶、任務追蹤、虛擬角色動畫與即時語音互動等功能。
在個人化方面，祖克柏表示，Meta並不認為AI應該只有單一人格。Muse允許使用者調整頭像、聲音與基本性格，讓使用者自行決定希望與AI如何互動。

每名代理配置獨立安全虛擬機

Meta為Muse設計的另一項核心基礎，是替每個代理配置獨立的安全虛擬機（Secure VM）。
祖克柏表示，個人代理將掌握大量使用者敏感資訊，因此Meta不希望這些資料與所有使用者的資訊混在同一個資料池。他將安全虛擬機比喻為放在使用者桌下、專屬於使用者的一台電腦。
相關資料會以加密方式儲存，密碼等敏感憑證則透過獨立安全模組管理，代理本身無法直接讀取。
此外，Meta還建立名為「Sentinel」的安全代理，負責監控Muse資料的進出。一旦發現異常或高風險操作，系統便會攔截，並要求使用者進一步授權。

Muse進軍Ray-Ban智慧眼鏡

Muse接下來的發展重點之一，是全面整合Ray-Ban智慧眼鏡。
祖克柏表示，目前智慧眼鏡主要採取單輪對話模式，使用者說出問題後獲得回答，互動便告一段落；Muse加入後，眼鏡將成為AI 代理的入口，使用者發出指令後，Muse可在後端安全虛擬機持續執行工作，再將結果回傳。
Meta目前也逐步建立不同層級的智慧眼鏡產品，包括沒有攝影機、以音訊功能為主的眼鏡；配備小型顯示器的Meta Ray-Ban；以及具備全視場角的全息AR原型。
祖克柏表示，Meta長期投入智慧眼鏡，讓公司在AI 代理逐漸成熟後擁有相應的產品基礎。過去較著重沉浸式體驗的元宇宙技術仍持續推進，但目前更多資源正轉向Muse與智慧眼鏡上的AI功能。
在虛擬化身方面，Meta過去需要透過房間級設備、多角度掃描與企業級GPU環境，才能打造高品質寫實化身；如今使用者只需提供少量照片，就能完成相關設定，且這項功能已可在VR眼鏡上運作。
祖克柏展望2030年表示，元宇宙的核心願景仍是連結實體與數位世界。未來人們可能與透過全息影像參與活動的朋友共同互動，在工作環境中，人類也能與多個AI 代理共同參與群組對話或會議。

Llama 4失誤成Meta AI發展轉折

不過，Meta的AI布局並非一路順利。祖克柏在訪談中坦言，Llama 4的表現不如預期，是他認為「最可怕的時刻」。
他表示，當時原本認為團隊正沿著正確方向前進，但結果卻出現重大偏差。
祖克柏將其中一項問題歸因於團隊組織方式。他過去曾以Instagram推薦系統或廣告系統的模式組建團隊，讓數百甚至上千名人員並行工作；但大型語言模型訓練需要的是規模較小、彼此高度協作的團隊，並將整個模型開發視為集體科學研究。
在Llama 4之後，Meta進行團隊重組，並從業界引進人才，成立Meta超級智慧實驗室（Meta Super Intelligence Lab，MSL）。
祖克柏亦透露，新一代模型即將推出，但不會在Connect大會上公開。

5吉瓦算力集群布局　祖克柏押注規模化訓練

談到通用人工智慧（AGI）的發展路徑，祖克柏認為，目前未必需要出現根本性的架構突破。他表示，如果能打造規模足夠龐大的超級電腦集群，或許可以透過增加算力來推進AGI。
Meta目前正在擴大AI訓練基礎設施。俄亥俄州超過1吉瓦的算力集群已基本投入使用，用於訓練下一代模型；路易斯安那州則正在興建5吉瓦級集群。
祖克柏表示，當訓練規模擴大至多吉瓦等級後，可能就能取得接近AGI甚至超級智慧的系統。
但他也指出，依靠算力擴張並不代表架構研究失去重要性。人腦運作所需功率約10瓦，而現有AI系統的能源效率仍低得多；若能同時結合大規模算力與架構上的突破，才可能取得更大的進展。

AI對齊成Muse能否普及的關鍵

對於AI安全與對齊問題，祖克柏認為，這不只是監管層面的要求，更是AI產品能否真正被使用的基本條件。
如果使用者要求Muse完成一項工作，但AI最終執行的方向完全相反，使用者自然不會繼續使用。因此，AI除了理解具體指令，也必須掌握使用者真正的意圖與價值觀。
祖克柏表示，如果Meta希望Muse最終觸及10億名使用者，就必須在AI對齊問題上取得重大進展。
他並以父母教育孩子作為比喻：如果AI為了完成一道程式設計題，選擇修改系統設定等方式走捷徑，應該讓AI理解這並非真正的解題方式，而是規避問題本身。

items.title: 全球AI交易考驗將來臨！三星與SK海力士第3季財報面臨「極高預期 」、記憶體漲價成焦點
paras: 人工智慧（AI）需求強勁成長，加上新一代記憶體技術持續推進，南韓兩大晶片巨頭三星電子(005930KS) 與SK海力士(000660KS) 正處於全球半導體景氣循環核心。隨著兩家公司第3季財報公布在即，市場高度關注其獲利表現，藉此觀察當前AI投資熱潮能否持續轉化為半導體企業的實際獲利。
《首爾經濟日報》引述FnGuide數據指出，市場預期三星電子第3季營收將達199.1兆韓元，營業利益105.6兆韓元；SK海力士營收及營業利益則分別預估為94.1兆韓元與74.1兆韓元。兩家公司合計營業利益可能接近189.9兆韓元，反映晶片供應吃緊下的市場需求。
不過，市場預期近期已出現調整。過去3個月，分析師將三星電子第3季營收與獲利預估分別下修2.6%及4.4%；SK海力士的營收與獲利預期也分別下調5.3%及5%。
相關調整主要受到韓元升值影響，使以美元計價的銷售額縮減，並非記憶體市場需求轉弱，但也讓匯率波動對兩大科技巨頭短期業績的影響受到市場關注。
除了營收與獲利規模，兩家公司即將公布的財報還將提供記憶體價格漲勢能否延續、長期供貨協議（LTA）對獲利的影響，以及下一代高頻寬記憶體（HBM）能否進一步轉化為獲利等訊號。

記憶體漲價速度放緩 LTA影響浮現

第2季DRAM與NAND 快閃記憶體平均售價（ASP）大幅上漲，是推動三星電子與SK海力士業績成長的主要動力。
進入第3季後，市場仍預期記憶體價格將持續走高，但漲幅可能放緩。Mirae Asset Securities預估，三星電子第3季DRAM ASP將上漲16.5%，但第4季漲幅可能縮小至5.4%，顯示價格反彈速度可能開始放緩。
長期供貨協議（LTA）的普及，也是影響記憶體價格與獲利的重要因素。
目前三星電子透過LTA鎖定約60%至70%的記憶體產能；SK海力士則已在第2季與約10家核心客戶完成LTA談判。
長約有助於企業穩定需求並降低記憶體產業價格劇烈波動的影響，但在價格快速上漲期間，由於合約價格通常落後現貨價格，也可能限制企業獲利向上成長的幅度。

HBM4進入量產競賽 AI記憶體需求升溫

下一代高頻寬記憶體HBM4同樣是第3季市場關注焦點。
隨著輝達(NVDA-US) 下一代AI平台Vera Rubin晶片出貨增加，三星電子預期第3季HBM4銷售額將較第2季增加逾一倍，並占2026年下半年HBM總營收逾60%。
SK海力士則需要在維持HBM3E市場領先地位的同時，持續擴大HBM4產能。第3季業績將提供市場觀察雙方HBM4競爭進展的初步線索。
根據《環球經濟》引述KB Securities報告，隨著Meta推出基於AI代理的AI應用Muse，AI服務正朝需要連續、順序操作及更高記憶體頻寬的方向發展。
KB Securities分析師Kim表示，AI資料中心中，GPU負責運算、CPU處理控制，而記憶體則負責資料供應與循環，因此AI資料中心的效能與效率，最終可能更加依賴記憶體。
這項變化也逐漸反映在整體半導體產業。超微半導體(AMD-US) 近期躋身由輝達、博通(AVGO-US) 與美光科技(MU-US) 組成的「兆美元市值俱樂部」，同時第2季資料中心營收年增107%，顯示市場對CPU與記憶體的關注度正快速提升，其重要性已不再低於GPU。
在產業布局方面，三星電子已開始關注下一代「zHBM」技術，計畫將記憶體直接堆疊在GPU上，並力拚在2027年底前提供樣品。

三星晶圓代工拚轉盈 DX部門面臨成本壓力

除了記憶體業務，三星電子晶圓代工業務的表現也受到市場關注。
三星晶圓代工自2023年以來持續虧損，但隨著4奈米語言處理單元（LPU）產能擴大及良率改善，市場普遍預期第3季有望轉虧為盈。若最終實現，將有助於改善長期拖累三星整體估值的晶圓代工業務。
另一方面，三星負責智慧手機及電視等業務的設備體驗（DX）部門則面臨零組件成本上升的壓力。
第2季儘管Galaxy Foldables等高階產品銷售強勁，仍未能抵銷零組件成本增加，DX部門錄得80億韓元營業虧損。隨著記憶體價格上漲，半導體部門獲利改善的同時，也增加終端硬體業務的成本壓力。
因此，第3季市場也將關注高階產品銷售能否抵銷成本上升，三星不同業務之間的獲利表現是否持續分化。

跨越「見頂」疑慮　市場重新檢視半導體長期估值

隨著第3季財報陸續公布，全球半導體市場的觀察重點，正逐漸從企業能賺多少錢，轉向這波獲利成長究竟能維持多久。
經歷過多輪景氣循環的投資人仍保持謹慎。若三星電子與SK海力士能證明LTA已穩定鎖定需求、HBM4能帶來可觀獲利，同時晶圓代工業務逐步恢復，這一輪半導體景氣循環的持續力道可能將與過去有所不同。
但若DRAM與NAND價格漲勢比預期更快降溫，或HBM4對獲利的實際貢獻低於市場預期，市場對半導體產業是否已經「見頂」的疑慮，也可能再次升溫。
未來幾週，三星電子與SK海力士的財報除了牽動兩家公司短期股價表現，也將成為市場判斷未來數年全球科技基礎建設投資趨勢的重要依據。

items.title: 輝達評估導入玻璃基板！最快2028年前應用於下一代GPU、與台積電等合作
items.title_en: Nvidia Evaluates Glass Substrates! Could Be Used in Next-Gen GPUs by 2028, Partnering with TSMC and Others
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 正持續探索下一代人工智慧（AI）晶片封裝技術，根據《首爾經濟日報》報導，輝達正評估採用玻璃基板方案，並與德國設備廠商SCHMID等業者展開合作。另據南韓科技媒體《KIPOST》報導，輝達希望南韓、日本及台灣基板廠商在2年內完成玻璃基板開發，最快可能在2028年前導入。
SCHMID在上半年財報說明會上透露，公司正與英特爾(INTC-US) 、輝達及超微半導體(AMD-US) 供應鏈中的核心供應商合作，共同開發玻璃基板相關設備。
不過，SCHMID策略長Roland Rettenmaier指出，玻璃通孔（Through-Glass Via，TGV）金屬化仍存在技術難題，目前客戶認證也尚未完成。
報導指出，輝達執行長黃仁勳此前曾與SK集團會長崔泰源會面，討論包括玻璃基板在內的下一代半導體合作，同時也積極推動台積電(2330-TW) 開發玻璃基板技術，顯示輝達正積極評估玻璃基板在下一代GPU上的應用。
輝達今年5月已與玻璃基板大廠康寧(GLW-US) 達成多年期策略合作。根據協議，輝達將向康寧投資最高27億美元並取得認股權證；康寧則計畫在美國新建3座先進製造廠，將當地光學連接產能擴大10倍，專門服務超大規模AI資料中心。
玻璃基板被視為新一代半導體封裝材料，主要目標是取代傳統有機基板。隨著AI晶片效能不斷提升，有機基板在耐熱性及翹曲變形等方面逐漸面臨技術瓶頸。
相較之下，玻璃基板具有較高的平整度與剛性，可望讓晶片運作速度提升約40%，同時降低近一半功耗。
玻璃基板的低熱膨脹係數也是重要優勢，在高溫環境下幾乎不會產生形變，對高發熱量的高效能AI晶片尤其重要。此外，玻璃具備良好介電特性與較低的訊號損耗，有助於穩定傳輸超高速訊號。
隨著基板尺寸擴大，玻璃基板的變形程度也相對較低，能在單一封裝中整合更多晶片與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）。
目前全球玻璃基板產業正從技術驗證階段，逐步進入中試、客戶認證及量產導入階段。
海外業者方面，英特爾持續推進Glass Core技術，DNP、三星電機、LG Innotek、Absolics等業者已進入試驗線及客戶送樣階段，量產時間點主要落在2028年前後；康寧、AGC及LPKF等材料與設備廠商也同步完善相關供應鏈。
中國大陸業者則加速推進產業化，京東方A(000725-CN) 、沃格光電(603773-CN) 、美迪凱(688079-CN) 、藍思科技(06613-HK) 等持續投入中試線建設、客戶驗證及小批量出貨，TGV成孔、金屬化及重布線（RDL）等環節的本土供應能力也逐步完善。
華創證券表示，玻璃芯基板應用於半導體先進封裝的長期發展空間廣大。隨著AI、高效能運算（HPC）及HBM帶動高階先進封裝需求增加，加上封裝朝更大尺寸發展，面板級封裝趨勢可望進一步凸顯玻璃基板在大尺寸、高平整度及低翹曲方面的優勢；共同封裝光學（CPO）及高頻射頻（RF）應用也可能拓展玻璃基板的應用領域。
華創證券進一步指出，從產業鏈來看，玻璃原片的中國大陸國產化目前仍處於早期階段；在玻璃通孔（GV）成孔及玻璃基板加工方面，部分中國大陸業者已實現設備出口及小批量重複採購。
電鍍及金屬化方面，部分業者的TGV添加劑及設備已完成交付測試，並形成批量出貨，逐步進入放量階段；RDL曝光及化學機械研磨（CMP）設備同樣受到市場關注。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) is actively exploring next‑generation AI chip packaging technologies and, according to the Seoul Economic Daily, is evaluating a glass‑substrate solution while collaborating with German equipment maker SCHMID and other partners. South Korean tech media KIPOST reports that Nvidia wants substrate manufacturers in South Korea, Japan and Taiwan to complete glass‑substrate development within two years, with possible adoption as early as before 2028.

SCHMID disclosed at its first‑half earnings briefing that the company is working with core suppliers in the Intel (INTC-US), Nvidia and AMD (AMD-US) supply chains to co‑develop equipment for glass substrates.
However, SCHMID’s strategy chief Roland Rettenmaier warned that metallizing through‑glass vias (TGV) still faces technical challenges and customer qualification has not yet been completed.

The report notes that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang previously met with SK Group chairman Choi Tae‑won to discuss next‑generation semiconductor collaborations, including glass substrates, and is also actively urging TSMC (2330‑TW) to develop glass‑substrate technology, indicating Nvidia’s strong interest in using glass substrates for its next‑gen GPUs.

In May this year Nvidia signed a multi‑year strategic partnership with glass‑substrate giant Corning (GLW-US). Under the agreement Nvidia will invest up to $2.7 billion in Corning and receive warrants, while Corning plans to build three advanced factories in the United States, expanding local optical‑interconnect capacity tenfold to serve massive AI data centers.

Glass substrates are seen as the next‑generation semiconductor packaging material, intended to replace traditional organic substrates. As AI chip performance climbs, organic substrates are hitting thermal‑resistance and warpage limits.
Compared with organic boards, glass offers higher flatness and rigidity, potentially boosting chip speed by about 40% while cutting power consumption by nearly half.

The low coefficient of thermal expansion of glass is another key advantage; it hardly deforms at high temperatures, which is critical for high‑heat, high‑performance AI chips. Glass also provides good dielectric properties and lower signal loss, helping to reliably carry ultra‑high‑speed signals.
As substrate sizes grow, glass deforms less, allowing more chips and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) to be integrated in a single package.
The global glass‑substrate industry is moving from technology‑validation into pilot production, customer qualification and volume‑production phases.

Overseas, Intel continues to push its Glass Core technology, and companies such as DNP, Samsung Electro‑Mechanics, LG Innotek and Absolics have entered test‑line and customer‑sample stages, with mass production expected around 2028; material and equipment firms like Corning, AGC and LPKF are also building out the supply chain.

In mainland China, firms such as BOE (000725-CN), Woguan Optoelectronics (603773-CN), Mediatek (688079-CN) and Lens Technology (06613-HK) are accelerating pilot‑line construction, customer validation and small‑batch shipments, gradually strengthening local capabilities for TGV drilling, metallization and redistribution layers (RDL).

Huachuang Securities says glass‑core substrates have vast long‑term potential in advanced semiconductor packaging. With AI, high‑performance computing (HPC) and HBM driving demand for high‑end advanced packages, and with packages moving to larger sizes, panel‑level packaging trends will further highlight glass’s advantages in size, flatness and low warpage; co‑packaged optics (CPO) and high‑frequency RF applications could also expand glass‑substrate use cases.

Huachuang adds that, from a supply‑chain perspective, domestic Chinese production of raw glass wafers is still in its early stage; for glass via (GV) formation and substrate processing, some Chinese firms have already achieved equipment exports and small‑batch repeat purchases.

In plating and metallization, some vendors have completed delivery testing of TGV additives and equipment and have begun batch shipments, moving toward volume scaling; RDL exposure and chemical‑mechanical polishing (CMP) equipment are likewise attracting market attention.

items.title: 原油運輸超級週期大爆發！BDTI飆5250點年漲逾100%、VLCC TCE突破百萬美元
items.title_en: Supercycle in Crude Oil Shipping Explodes! BDTI Soars 5,250 Points, Up Over 100% YoY, VLCC TCE Breaks $1 Million
paras: 美伊衝突持續擾亂全球原油運輸航線，油輪繞行、轉運等因素推升有效運力損失，加上油輪供給處於歷史低檔，全球油運價格今年以來持續走高。
Wind數據顯示，截至9月24日，波羅的海原油輪指數（BDTI）升至5250點，年初以來漲幅超過100%，較2025年初約850點更大增逾5倍。值得注意的是，今年以來超過100%的漲幅，主要集中在最近一個月。
中信證券分析指出，目前油輪運價仍未充分反映供需緊張程度，傳統航運週期的供需分析模式需要因應市場變化調整，2026年油輪龍頭企業的估值與獲利有望創下歷史新高。
2025年初，BDTI仍在800至850點低檔徘徊，之後整體呈現震盪走高，至2025年底已升至約2500點。
進入2026年後，美伊衝突成為影響全球油運價格的重要因素。衝突初期，市場出現原油搶運，大型油輪運價快速飆升；隨後荷姆茲海峽關閉，BDTI一度回落至1800點附近。
不過，7月以來BDTI重新持續上行，9月漲勢尤其明顯。9月1日至24日，BDTI從2676點一路升至5250點，單月截至24日漲幅接近一倍。
油運價格走高也帶動相關A股上市公司業績成長。以油運為主要業務的中遠海能、招商輪船，今年上半年歸屬母公司股東淨利潤均大幅增加。
中遠海能(01138-HK) 上半年營收151.5億元人民幣，年增30%；歸母淨利潤45.45億元人民幣，年增143.21%。招商輪船(601872-CN) 上半年營收196.5億元人民幣，年增56.2%；歸母淨利潤69.60億元人民幣，年增227.57%。
若拆分油運業務，機構估算招商輪船第2季油運板塊營收約55.2億元人民幣，年增139.2%；淨利潤約37億元人民幣，年增359.5%，較第1季增加49%。
業績大幅成長也反映在股價表現上。中遠海能今年以來股價上漲88%，招商輪船年內漲幅則超過136.75%，市值持續創下新高。

有效運力損失與貨盤增加 推升油輪運價

在油運價格持續上漲之際，包括中信證券(600030-CN) 、國泰海通(02611-HK) 在內的機構仍對後續運價維持相對樂觀看法。
國泰海通近期研報指出，過去一個月中東暗航貨量持續增加，目前每日出口量達1400萬至1600萬桶，估計已恢復至衝突前的八至九成；美灣與西非自8月以來的出口量，年增幅也達一至兩成。
與此同時，暗航轉運及紅海繞行造成合規運力效率明顯下降。在供需邊際改善及船東信心升高的情況下，油輪運價快速攀升，美灣與西非VLCC 等價期租租金（TCE）已升至40萬至53萬美元。
此外，VLCC一年期期租升至18萬美元，五年期期租則超過6萬美元，反映市場對油運產業中期前景的預期。
國泰海通認為，地緣政治因素正在強化油運產業中長期邏輯，高景氣持續時間可能超出預期，且仍具備需求意外增加的可能性。
中信證券則指出，目前市場關注油運價格創歷史新高後能否延續，以及旺季運價是否還有進一步上漲空間。該機構認為，當前核心矛盾在於有效運力損失持續擴大，並與貨盤增加形成共振，進一步壓縮運輸端供給，短期運價仍具備上漲韌性。
根據Clarksons數據，截至9月18日當週，VLCC與Aframax平均TCE分別較前一週增加42.3%及18.5%，升至每日63.1萬美元及17.7萬美元，均創歷史新高。其中，波斯灣地區VLCC TCE更突破每日100萬美元。
中信證券表示，有效運力持續損失已成為值得關注的邊際變數。目前中東地區貨物有超過85%透過各種形式的中轉運輸，富查伊拉及埃及艾因港的碼頭壅塞情況也日益明顯；隨著後續船舶進入船廠維修，市場可能進一步面臨「一船難求」的情況，成為短期推升運價的重要支撐。
中信證券指出，暗航、繞行及海灣船對船轉運持續消耗有效運力，運價上漲也明顯從特定航線擴散至不同船型。在
油輪供給緊張的情況下，市場已出現每日100萬美元以上的TCE；部分品種裂解價差超過每桶100美元，也進一步強化大宗商品貿易商及海灣產油國的搶貨動機。
中信證券預期，節後10月至11月貨盤將優於9月，旺季運價表現可能超出預期，並持續看好油運產業供需結構的變化。
paras_en: The ongoing US‑Iran conflict continues to disrupt global crude oil shipping routes, with tanker detours and transshipments increasing effective capacity losses. Coupled with historically low tanker supply, global oil freight rates have been rising steadily this year.

Wind data shows that as of September 24 the Baltic Dirty Tanker Index (BDTI) climbed to 5,250 points, more than a 100% gain since the start of the year and over five times the roughly 850‑point level at the beginning of 2025. Notably, the more than 100% rise this year has been concentrated in the past month.

CITIC Securities analysts note that current tanker freight rates still do not fully reflect the tightness of supply and demand, and the traditional shipping‑cycle supply‑demand analysis model needs to be adjusted for market changes. Valuations and earnings of leading tanker firms in 2026 are expected to hit historic highs.
At the start of 2025 the BDTI lingered in the low 800‑850‑point range, then gradually rose in a volatile upward trend, reaching about 2,500 points by the end of 2025.

After entering 2026, the US‑Iran conflict became a key driver of global oil freight prices. In the early stage of the clash, a scramble for crude led to a rapid surge in large‑tanker rates; later, the closure of the Hormuz Strait pulled the BDTI down to around 1,800 points.

Since July, however, the BDTI has resumed its upward climb, with September showing especially strong gains. From September 1 to 24 the index jumped from 2,676 points to 5,250 points, almost doubling in a single month.

Higher freight rates have also boosted earnings for related A‑share listed companies. COSCO Shipping Energy (01138‑HK) and China Merchants Bulk Shipping (601872‑CN), whose main business is oil transport, both saw a sharp increase in net profit attributable to shareholders in the first half of the year.

COSCO Shipping Energy posted first‑half revenue of RMB 15.15 billion, up 30% year‑on‑year, and net profit of RMB 4.545 billion, up 143.21%. China Merchants Bulk Shipping reported first‑half revenue of RMB 19.65 billion, up 56.2%, and net profit of RMB 6.96 billion, up 227.57%.

If the oil‑shipping segment is separated, analysts estimate that China Merchants Bulk Shipping’s Q2 oil‑shipping revenue was about RMB 5.52 billion, up 139.2% YoY, with net profit around RMB 3.7 billion, up 359.5% and 49% higher than Q1.

The strong earnings growth is reflected in share‑price performance. COSCO Shipping Energy’s stock has risen 88% so far this year, while China Merchants Bulk Shipping is up more than 136.75%, pushing its market value to fresh highs.

Effective capacity losses and increasing cargo volumes are pushing tanker rates higher. While oil freight prices keep climbing, institutions such as CITIC Securities (600030‑CN) and Guotai Hai Tong (02611‑HK) remain relatively optimistic about future rates.

Guotai Hai Tong’s recent research notes that in the past month Middle‑East clandestine cargo volumes have kept rising, now reaching 14‑16 million barrels per day, roughly 80‑90% of pre‑conflict levels. Export volumes from the US Gulf and West Africa have also grown 10‑20% year‑on‑year since August.

At the same time, covert transshipments and Red Sea detours have markedly reduced the efficiency of compliant capacity. With marginal supply‑demand improvement and higher shipowner confidence, tanker rates have surged, with US Gulf and West Africa VLCC time‑charter equivalents (TCE) climbing to $400,000‑$530,000 per day.
Furthermore, VLCC one‑year charters have risen to $180,000 and five‑year charters exceed $60,000, reflecting market expectations for the medium‑term outlook of the oil‑shipping sector.

Guotai Hai Tong believes geopolitical factors are strengthening the medium‑ to long‑term logic of the oil‑shipping industry, suggesting the high‑growth period could last longer than expected and that demand may still see unexpected spikes.

CITIC Securities points out that the market is watching whether record‑high freight rates can be sustained and whether there is further upside in peak‑season pricing. The firm sees the core issue as the continued expansion of effective capacity loss, which resonates with growing cargo volumes, further tightening supply and giving short‑term rates upward resilience.

According to Clarksons data, in the week ending September 18 VLCC and Aframax average TCEs rose 42.3% and 18.5% respectively from the previous week, reaching $631,000 and $177,000 per day – both historic highs. In the Persian Gulf region, VLCC TCE even broke the $1 million‑per‑day mark.

CITIC Securities says the ongoing loss of effective capacity has become a key marginal variable. Over 85% of Middle‑East cargo now moves through various forms of transshipment, and congestion at ports such as Fujairah and Egypt’s Ain Sokhna is worsening. As more vessels head to shipyards for repairs, the market may face a “one‑ship‑hard‑to‑find” situation, further supporting short‑term rate gains.

CITIC Securities notes that clandestine voyages, detours and Gulf‑region vessels continuously drain effective capacity, and rate hikes are clearly spreading from specific routes to different vessel types.

With tanker supply tight, the market has already seen TCEs exceeding $1 million per day; some product crack spreads are over $100 per barrel, further intensifying the buying drive of commodity traders and Gulf oil‑producing nations.

CITIC Securities expects cargo volumes in October‑November after the holiday break to outpace September, potentially delivering peak‑season freight rates that exceed expectations, and remains bullish on the evolving supply‑demand dynamics of the oil‑shipping industry.

items.title: 美國兩黨推法案限制中國光模組！新易盛、中際旭創列管  AI資料中心恐受衝擊
items.title_en: US Bipartisan Bill to Restrict Chinese Optical Modules; New Yi Sheng and Zhongji Xuchuang Added to Controls, AI Data Centers May Be Impacted
paras: 美國國會兩黨議員近日聯手提出法案，計畫禁止聯邦政府在涉及敏感資訊的政府系統中使用中國製光模組（光收發器），以降低相關設備對美國人工智慧（AI）資料中心及政府系統的潛在風險。
這項法案於9月25日提出，由共和黨參議員John Cornyn、Dave McCormick，以及民主黨參議員John Fetterman、Ruben Gallego共同提出，限制對象包括中國光通訊設備業者成都新易盛(300502-CN) 及中際旭創(300308-CN) 生產的光模組。
此前，美國國防部已將中際旭創等企業列入「1260H清單」。
光模組主要負責在光纖與電子設備之間轉換訊號，讓資料能透過光纖高速傳輸，是AI資料中心基礎設施的重要零組件，部分大型資料中心甚至需要數百萬個相關設備。
法案支持者表示，相關中國製產品可能影響美國對AI工具及雲端服務的存取。
此次立法也進一步加大美國對中國光模組製造商的限制壓力。相關中國業者目前在AI資料中心關鍵零組件市場占有重要地位。
不過，美國科技業者對限制措施有所疑慮，認為若限制中國供應商，可能使美國AI基礎設施建設速度放緩，並讓中國取得先發優勢，原因在於超大規模資料中心業者正加速尋找其他供應來源。
科技遊說團體資訊科技產業委員會（ITIC）8月曾致函美國聯邦通信委員會（FCC），呼籲不要將光模組列入貿易黑名單。
ITIC指出，供應中斷可能影響資料中心部署速度，以及美國在AI領域的領先地位。
美國創新基金會（ITIF）一份報告則指出，美國Coherent(COHR-US) 與魯門特姆控股(LITE-US) 均能提供具競爭力的光模組技術，但目前產能規模仍不足以完全取代中國供應商。
若法案最終獲得通過，美國政府將有5年時間完成相關規定的落實；此外，美國商務部長與國防部長也將擁有權限，將其他企業加入限制名單。
paras_en: U.S. lawmakers from both parties have recently teamed up to introduce legislation that would ban the federal government from using Chinese-made optical modules (optical transceivers) in government systems that handle sensitive information, aiming to reduce the potential risk these devices pose to U.S. artificial‑intelligence (AI) data centers and government networks.

The bill, filed on September 25, was co‑sponsored by Republican Senators John Cornyn and Dave McCormick and Democratic Senators John Fetterman and Ruben Gallego, and targets optical modules produced by Chinese optical‑communications firms Chengdu New Yi Sheng (300502‑CN) and Zhongji Xuchuang (300308‑CN).
Previously, the U.S. Department of Defense had already placed companies such as Zhongji Xuchuang on the so‑called “1260H List.”

Optical modules are responsible for converting signals between fiber‑optic cables and electronic equipment, enabling high‑speed data transmission over fiber and serving as a critical component of AI data‑center infrastructure; some large data centers require millions of such devices.
Supporters of the bill argue that the Chinese products could jeopardize U.S. access to AI tools and cloud services.
The legislation would further intensify pressure on Chinese optical‑module manufacturers, which currently hold a significant share of the market for key AI data‑center components.

However, U.S. technology companies have expressed concerns that restricting Chinese suppliers could slow the construction of American AI infrastructure and give China a first‑mover advantage, as hyperscale data‑center operators are racing to find alternative sources.

The Information Technology Industry Council (ITIC), a tech lobbying group, wrote to the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) in August urging the agency not to place optical modules on a trade blacklist.
ITIC warned that supply disruptions could delay data‑center deployments and undermine the United States’ leadership in AI.

A report from the Information Technology and Innovation Foundation (ITIF) noted that U.S. firms Coherent (COHR‑US) and Lumentum Holdings (LITE‑US) can provide competitive optical‑module technology, but their current production capacity is insufficient to fully replace Chinese suppliers.

If the bill ultimately passes, the U.S. government would have five years to implement the new rules; additionally, the Secretary of Commerce and the Secretary of Defense would be granted authority to add other companies to the restriction list.

items.title: 台積電又有漲價題材！「含積量」成焦點 00881包下AI四大電子族群
items.title_en: TSMC Again Has Price‑Rise Theme! “High‑Weight” Becomes Focus, 00881 Packs AI’s Four Major Electronic Sectors
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)傳出 2027 年晶圓代工報價調升 3%~6%，帶動高「含積量」ETF 熱度，隨著 AI 商機擴散至伺服器、PCB、散熱與光通訊，科技股不再由台積電獨秀。券商建議，科技業輪動快，相較追單一股票，不如布局涵蓋四大電子的國泰台灣科技龍頭 ETF(00881-TW)，該基金規模逾 1571 億元，台積電持股近4成，並兼顧整體 AI 供應鏈。
券商表示，直接看數字最有感，觀察近10年回測資料，00881追蹤指數累積報酬率達1,317.1%，明顯高於同期台灣50指數的939.7%及加權指數729.1%；年化報酬率22.5%，也高於台灣50的20.7%與加權指數18.3%。換句話說，拉長投資時間，科技股不只扮演台股多頭主力，長期成長力道也相對突出。

不過，科技股雖強，每年帶頭衝的卻未必是同一族群。回顧2022年台股修正，半導體、電子零組件、其他電子及電腦週邊同步走弱；行情回溫後，領漲棒子隨即開始輪流交接，2023年由電腦及週邊設備率先突圍，2024年換其他電子居冠，2025年電子零組件接棒並延續至今，今年以來電子零組件漲幅依然高居四大電子產業之首。因此，券商提醒，從近年走勢來看，AI商機也正由晶片向伺服器、PCB、散熱及零組件持續外溢，科技投資不只要抓龍頭，也要抓得到下一棒。
根據國泰投信官網資料，00881目前半導體業占59.51%、電子零組件業18.97%、其他電子業8.03%、電腦及週邊設備業6.2%，四大電子產業合計占比逾九成；進一步觀察持股結構，00881不僅台積電權重達38.23%，聯發科占11.88%、台達電6.02%、鴻海4.68%，另有聯電、欣興、川湖、台光電、奇鋐及大立光等科技指標股。
從晶圓製造、IC設計、伺服器組裝，到PCB、散熱與光學元件皆有布局，不是只押一座「台積電高峰」，而是一次包進整片科技「群山」，讓投資人有機會同時參與不同次產業的成長與輪動。
展望後市，00881基金經理人蘇鼎宇表示，AI投資主軸仍持續從晶片向伺服器、網通、高速傳輸、散熱及終端應用擴散，科技產業中長期成長方向未變；不過，在台股高檔震盪、類股輪動加快的環境下，個別族群漲跌差異也可能放大。投資人若看好科技產業長期趨勢，可依自身風險承受度，透過ETF分散布局，並採定期定額、分批投入方式參與台灣科技產業長線成長。

paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) is rumored to raise its wafer‑foundry pricing for 2027 by 3%‑6%, sparking interest in high‑weight ETFs. As AI opportunities spread to servers, PCBs, cooling and optical communications, tech stocks are no longer dominated solely by TSMC. Brokers suggest that because the tech sector rotates quickly, it may be better to allocate to Cathay Taiwan Technology Leaders ETF (00881‑TW), which covers the four major electronic groups, rather than chase a single stock. The fund now exceeds NT$157.1 billion, with TSMC accounting for nearly 40% of holdings while also covering the broader AI supply chain.

Brokers point out that the numbers speak for themselves: over the past ten years the index tracked by 00881 has delivered a cumulative return of 1,317.1%, clearly outpacing the Taiwan 50’s 939.7% and the overall weighted index’s 729.1%. Its annualised return is 22.5%, also higher than the Taiwan 50’s 20.7% and the weighted index’s 18.3%. In other words, over a longer investment horizon tech stocks not only drive the Taiwan market’s bullishness but also show superior long‑term growth potential.

However, while tech stocks are strong, the leading sub‑sector changes year by year. Looking back at the 2022 Taiwan market correction, semiconductor, electronic components, other electronics and computer peripherals all weakened together. After the market recovered, the leading “sticks” rotated: in 2023 computers and peripherals led the rally, in 2024 other electronics took the top spot, and in 2025 electronic components seized the lead and have continued to do so this year, remaining the biggest gainer among the four electronic industries. Brokers therefore note that AI opportunities are flowing from chips to servers, PCBs, cooling and components, so tech investing should capture both the current leaders and the next wave.

According to Cathay Asset Management’s website, 00881’s current sector breakdown is 59.51% semiconductor, 18.97% electronic components, 8.03% other electronics and 6.20% computer and peripheral equipment – together exceeding 90% of the fund. Looking at the top holdings, TSMC accounts for 38.23% of the fund, MediaTek 11.88%, Delta Electronics 6.02%, Foxconn 4.68%, with other notable tech stocks such as UMC, Unimicron, Chuan Hsu, Taiwan Photonics, Qihong and Largan Precision also represented.

The fund’s exposure spans wafer manufacturing, IC design, server assembly, PCB production, cooling solutions and optical components – it is not just betting on a single “TSMC peak” but rather bundling an entire “mountain range” of technology, giving investors the chance to participate in the growth and rotation of multiple sub‑industries simultaneously.

Looking ahead, 00881 fund manager Su Ding‑Yu says the AI investment theme will continue to spread from chips to servers, networking, high‑speed transmission, cooling and end‑user applications, and the medium‑ to long‑term growth direction of the tech sector remains unchanged. However, in a high‑level, volatile Taiwan market with faster sector rotation, the performance gap between sub‑sectors may widen. Investors who are bullish on the long‑term tech trend can match their risk tolerance by using the ETF for diversified exposure, employing regular‑interval or staggered purchases to capture Taiwan’s tech sector’s long‑term growth.

items.title: 雄獅創兩個新里程碑 帶進國旅新客源、拓高端主題版圖
items.title_en: Lion Travel Sets Two New Milestones, Bringing New Domestic Tourists and Expanding High-End Themed Offerings
paras: 旅行社龍頭雄獅(2731-TW)宣示將日本作為全球布局的關鍵樞紐，因此本周末首度以獨立展館之姿，進駐亞洲指標性旅遊盛會「東京旅展」(Tourism EXPO Japan)，同時，雄獅近期開出在台首家高爾夫門市，在龐大的旅遊商機下，持續開創新的營運動能。
雄獅今年設定以北美 (洛杉磯、溫哥華) 和亞洲 (東京、沖繩、泰國) 雙架構，強化國際版圖布局，並陸續於鳳凰城、熊本和捷克增設全球據點。
雄獅表態看好日本出入境旅遊市場，近年出團人次逐月倍數成長，客群涵蓋全球旅客，而為做出市場差異化，此次將長期耕耘的台灣鐵道觀光資源引進日本市場，主要是雄獅獨家營運的台灣七大鐵道觀光列車，包括主打奢華的「鳴日號」、「鳴日廚房」、質感女性最愛的「海風號」和「山嵐號」、阿里山林鐵「福森號」和「栩悅號」，以及富含懷舊韻味的「藍皮解憂號」。
在本次展館中，雄獅以「世界旅遊列車」，目標帶領旅客從日本出發探索台灣。
此外，近期雄獅也積極拓展國內高端市場，近期在台北大直全新室內高爾夫場域「Club M 樂富高爾夫球會」，設立全台第一間高爾夫旅遊主題門市，主要是因觀察近三年高球旅遊需求快速升溫，尤其賽事型高球訂單數三年成長幅度高達60%，且整體平均預訂期則由2.3個月拉長至3.7個月。
其中，雄獅高單價的長線(美洲、歐洲、大洋洲)高球團是近三年成長最快的區塊，三年成長近4倍，且歐美球團平均預訂期達3.6至6.4個月，顯示長線球場資源稀缺、行程規劃複雜，旅客更傾向提前卡位。
雄獅看好，透過精準分眾建構具競爭力的產品線，積極拓展設計主題旅遊團與毛利較高產品。
法人則指出，觀察到旅遊市場因競爭者眾，再加上旅遊元件的成本大漲，是否衝擊到後續旅遊業的獲利動能有待觀察，不過，大者恆大的旅行社更具競爭優勢。
paras_en: Lion Travel (2731‑TW), the leading travel agency, announced that Japan will serve as a key hub in its global strategy. This weekend it made its debut as an independent pavilion at the flagship Asian tourism event, the Tokyo Travel Expo, and has also recently opened Taiwan’s first dedicated golf outlet, continuing to generate new operational momentum amid a booming travel market.

Lion Travel has set a dual‑region focus for this year, targeting North America (Los Angeles, Vancouver) and Asia (Tokyo, Okinawa, Thailand) to strengthen its international footprint, and is adding new global bases in Phoenix, Kumamoto and the Czech Republic.

Lion Travel expressed confidence in Japan’s inbound and outbound tourism market, noting that group departures have been growing exponentially month‑by‑month in recent years, attracting travelers from around the world. To differentiate its offering, the company will introduce Taiwan’s railway tourism assets to Japan, featuring its exclusive seven Taiwan railway sightseeing trains: the luxury “Mingri,” “Mingri Kitchen,” the stylish women‑favored “Sea Breeze” and “Mountain Storm,” the Alishan forest rail “Fuson” and “Xuyue,” and the nostalgic “Blue‑Skin Comfort.”
At the exhibition, Lion Travel presented the “World Travel Train” concept, aiming to guide travelers from Japan to explore Taiwan.

In addition, Lion Travel is actively expanding into Taiwan’s high‑end domestic market, opening the country’s first golf‑themed travel boutique at the new indoor golf facility “Club M Le Fu Golf Club” in Taipei’s Dazhi district. This move follows a rapid rise in golf‑travel demand over the past three years, with tournament‑type golf bookings growing 60% and the average booking window extending from 2.3 to 3.7 months.

Lion Travel’s high‑price, long‑lead‑time golf tours to the Americas, Europe and Oceania have been the fastest‑growing segment, nearly quadrupling over three years. European and American groups now book 3.6‑to‑6.4‑month in advance, reflecting scarce long‑lead‑time course resources and complex itinerary planning, prompting travelers to secure slots early.
Lion Travel is optimistic that precise audience segmentation will build a competitive product line, actively developing themed tours and higher‑margin offerings.

Industry analysts note that intense competition and soaring travel‑component costs could pressure future profitability in the tourism sector, but larger travel agencies like Lion Travel are likely to retain a competitive edge.

items.title: AI散熱需求催油門 12吋SiC發展加速 單晶、多晶、鍵合三路競逐
items.title_en: AI Cooling Demand Accelerates SiC Growth: 12‑inch SiC Development Speeds Up as Monocrystalline, Polycrystalline, and Bonded Paths Compete
paras: AI與HPC晶片功耗持續攀升，先進封裝散熱需求同步升溫，也讓過去主要應用在電動車、再生能源與功率半導體的碳化矽(SiC)，開始切入AI先進封裝新戰場。隨著應用版圖擴大，SiC產業也加速朝12吋大尺寸發展，包括Resonac、住友金屬礦山以及台廠盛新等業者近期接連宣布技術突破，單晶、鍵合與多晶SiC等不同技術路線同步升溫，12吋SiC路線戰正式開打。
Resonac日前宣布，已成功長出並加工12吋SiC單晶基板，為目前全球開發中的最大尺寸SiC基板之一。
Resonac此次特別點出新應用，如AI伺服器與HPC，單晶SiC相較傳統矽材料，具有高導熱特性，因此除了作為功率半導體材料，也開始被AI晶片的散熱應用所關注，有機會成為散熱基板及先進封裝使用，且因SiC具備高折射率特性，也具備切入AR智慧眼鏡等光學應用的潛力。
除了Resonac直接挑戰12吋單晶SiC，另一條技術路線則是透過「鍵合」降低昂貴單晶SiC的使用量。住友金屬礦山日前也宣布，成功開發12吋鍵合SiC基板，並已送樣給半導體廠，為全球首款12吋鍵合SiC基板，並預計將在近日登場的ICSCRM 2026展示。
業界指出，鍵合SiC的概念，是不再讓整片基板都使用高成本單晶SiC，而是在較便宜的支撐基板上，鍵合一層高品質、極薄的單晶SiC功能層，在保留單晶SiC電性與材料特性的同時，大幅降低單晶材料耗用量。
住友金屬曾表示，其SiC基板鍵合技術可透過直接鍵合方式，在維持單晶SiC特性的同時，達到低電阻、高強度等效果，目前6吋、8吋產品已可提供客戶使用。公司先前的鍵合SiC也已用於SiC MOSFET。
另外，中國業者泰坦未來則宣布推出12吋的多晶SiC基板，同樣鎖定AI先進封裝用的散熱基板等高溫散熱等領域。不過，業界認為，多晶SiC本身無法直接取代單晶SiC，而是透過扮演鍵合SiC的底層材料，切入高導熱、高溫製程等應用，因此隨著12吋鍵合SiC逐步發展，大尺寸多晶SiC的重要性也同步提高。
除了日本、中國業者，美國及台灣廠商也陸續投入，如美國龍頭Wolfspeed早在今年1月就已展示12吋單晶SiC技術，在當時被視為是突破技術的里程碑，盛新材料也在近日揭露12吋SiC晶球的開發成果，應用同樣以AI先進封裝與AR智慧眼鏡市場為主。
過去SiC主要成長動能來自電動車逆變器、充電樁與能源基礎建設，但隨著AI需求崛起，SiC迎來新市場，一方面，AI資料中心需要高效率電源轉換，持續拉升SiC功率元件需求；另一方面，GPU、ASIC等AI晶片功耗不斷增加，也讓高導熱SiC有機會進一步進入晶片散熱與先進封裝材料領域。
業界認為，12吋SiC隨著AI應用加入，業界競爭焦點正逐步轉向「低成本、大尺寸同時高品質且高導熱的SiC材料」，目前多家業者路線競爭升溫，成為百家爭鳴的新戰場。
paras_en: AI and HPC chip power consumption continues to rise, driving up the heat‑dissipation needs of advanced packaging. This has opened the door for silicon carbide (SiC)—previously dominated by electric‑vehicle, renewable‑energy and power‑semiconductor applications—to enter the AI advanced‑packaging arena. As the application scope expands, the SiC industry is accelerating toward 12‑inch wafer sizes, with recent breakthroughs announced by Resonac, Sumitomo Metal Mining and Taiwan’s Sheng‑Xin. Monocrystalline, bonded and polycrystalline SiC technologies are all heating up, officially launching the 12‑inch SiC race.
Resonac recently announced that it has successfully grown and processed a 12‑inch monocrystalline SiC wafer, one of the largest SiC substrates under development worldwide.

Resonac highlighted new applications such as AI servers and HPC. Compared with traditional silicon, monocrystalline SiC offers high thermal conductivity, making it attractive not only as a power‑semiconductor material but also for AI chip cooling. It could serve as a heat‑spreading substrate and in advanced packaging, and its high refractive index gives it potential for optical uses such as AR smart glasses.

In addition to Resonac’s direct challenge with 12‑inch monocrystalline SiC, another route reduces the amount of expensive monocrystalline SiC by using “bonded” wafers. Sumitomo Metal Mining recently announced the successful development of a 12‑inch bonded SiC substrate, which has already been sent to semiconductor customers. It is the world’s first 12‑inch bonded SiC wafer and is slated for display at the upcoming ICSCRM 2026 conference.

Industry observers explain that bonded SiC works by attaching a thin, high‑quality monocrystalline SiC functional layer onto a cheaper supporting substrate. This retains the electrical and material advantages of monocrystalline SiC while dramatically cutting the consumption of the costly single‑crystal material.

Sumitomo Metal has said its SiC bonding technology can achieve low resistance and high strength while preserving monocrystalline SiC characteristics through direct bonding. Products in 6‑inch and 8‑inch sizes are already available to customers, and the company’s bonded SiC has previously been used in SiC MOSFETs.

Meanwhile, China’s Titan Future announced a 12‑inch polycrystalline SiC wafer aimed at high‑temperature cooling substrates for AI advanced packaging. However, the industry notes that polycrystalline SiC cannot directly replace monocrystalline SiC; instead, it serves as the base material for bonded SiC, enabling high‑thermal‑conductivity, high‑temperature processes. As bonded 12‑inch SiC matures, the importance of large‑size polycrystalline SiC rises in tandem.

Beyond Japanese and Chinese players, U.S. and Taiwanese firms are also joining the race. U.S. leader Wolfspeed showcased its 12‑inch monocrystalline SiC technology in January, hailed as a milestone breakthrough, while Taiwan’s Sheng‑Xin Materials recently revealed progress on 12‑inch SiC crystal balls, targeting AI advanced packaging and AR smart‑glass markets.

Historically, SiC growth has been driven by electric‑vehicle inverters, charging stations and energy infrastructure. With the surge in AI demand, SiC is entering a new market: AI data centers need highly efficient power conversion, boosting demand for SiC power devices, while the rising power draw of GPUs, ASICs and other AI chips creates opportunities for high‑thermal‑conductivity SiC in chip cooling and advanced‑packaging materials.

Industry insiders believe that as AI applications adopt 12‑inch SiC, competition is shifting toward “low‑cost, large‑size, high‑quality, high‑thermal‑conductivity” SiC materials. Multiple companies are intensifying their respective routes, turning the sector into a bustling battlefield of innovation.

items.title: 鴻海攻具身智能機器人 旗下富士康攜手阿爾特成立富特康
items.title_en: Foxconn Pursues Embodied Intelligent Robots, Foxconn Partners with Alt to Launch Futekang
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)旗下富士康科技集團與中國汽車技術公司阿爾特(300825-CN)，合資公司北京富特康智能機器人科技近日正式成立，並與松延動力、影智科技及蘿博派對等多家業者簽署合作協議，從技術合作進一步邁向實體營運，聚焦具身智能機器人從研發、中試到量產的產業化服務。
富特康將整合富士康的設計、研發、供應鏈及製造體系，以及阿爾特的核心技術與汽車客戶資源，打通「技術研發、中試產品化、規模量產」流程，提供從概念開發到量產的服務，公司也將結合雙方在汽車工業及電子工業領域的客戶基礎，拓展具身智能機器人在多元工業場景的應用，並透過工程化能力及規模化採購，降低中試與量產成本。
目前機器人產業從實驗室樣機走向規模化量產，仍面臨供應鏈整合、工程驗證及製造成本等挑戰，導致部分創新專案仍停留在樣品階段。為加速突破量產瓶頸，富士康與阿爾特共同推出機器人「Turn-Key」全方位平台，涵蓋研發、生產、訓練、銷售及投資五大面向，富特康則作為平台的實體營運載體。
富特康相關負責人表示，把實驗室裡的可能性變成生產線上可以依賴的確定性，量產的確定性才是產業爆發的前提，因此，透過平台型企業的營運模式，將串聯上下游產業資源及全國主要產業聚落，推動機器人產業跨區域協同，同時結合富士康與阿爾特的全球化能力，拓展全球智慧設備市場。
阿爾特董事長宣奇武表示，具身智能需要多方協作，富特康將為創新團隊提供從概念到量產的服務，協助更多專案跨越「最後一公里」。阿爾特具備20年開發經驗，累積開發500款車型，在結構動力學、工程模擬、供應鏈整合及車規級驗證等領域具備相關能力，並已布局機器人領域，與光輪智能、宇信科技、銀河通用等企業建立合作關係。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) subsidiary Foxconn Technology Group and Chinese automotive technology company Alt (300825‑CN) have officially established the joint venture Beijing Futekang Intelligent Robot Technology, and have signed cooperation agreements with several firms including Songyan Power, Yingzhi Technology and Luo Bo Party, moving from technical collaboration to actual operations and focusing on industrialized services for embodied intelligent robots from R&D and pilot production to mass production.

Futekang will integrate Foxconn’s design, R&D, supply‑chain and manufacturing systems with Alt’s core technologies and automotive customer resources, streamlining the “technology development‑pilot productization‑scale mass production” process to offer end‑to‑end services from concept to volume manufacturing. The company will also leverage both parties’ customer bases in the automotive and electronics sectors to expand applications of embodied intelligent robots across diverse industrial settings, and use engineering capabilities and large‑scale procurement to reduce pilot and mass‑production costs.

The robot industry is still transitioning from laboratory prototypes to scale‑up production, facing challenges such as supply‑chain integration, engineering validation and manufacturing costs, which keep many innovative projects at the sample stage. To accelerate breakthroughs in mass production, Foxconn and Alt jointly launched a “Turn‑Key” full‑stack robot platform covering R&D, production, training, sales and investment, with Futekang serving as the physical operating entity of the platform.

A Futekang executive said that turning laboratory possibilities into reliable production‑line certainty is the prerequisite for industry explosion, so the platform‑based operating model will link upstream and downstream resources and major industrial clusters nationwide, promote cross‑regional collaboration in the robot sector, and combine Foxconn’s and Alt’s global capabilities to expand the worldwide smart‑equipment market.

Alt Chairman Xuan Qiwu stated that embodied intelligence requires multi‑party collaboration; Futekang will provide innovative teams with services from concept to mass production, helping more projects cross the “last mile.” Alt brings 20 years of development experience, having created 500 vehicle models and possessing expertise in structural dynamics, engineering simulation, supply‑chain integration and automotive‑grade verification, and has already entered the robot field, establishing partnerships with companies such as Guanglun Intelligent, Yuxin Technology and Galaxy General.

items.title: 〈房產〉北北桃五大「人口磁吸區」成型  淡水、林口機能成熟吸納移居人口
items.title_en: <Real Estate> Five Emerging "Population Magnet" Areas in Northern Taipei, New Taipei, and Taoyuan Take Shape; Tamsui and Linkou Mature in Attracting Relocating Residents
paras: 密集的交通網絡，讓北、北、桃通勤生活圈成形，而雙北市的高昂房價，也驅動預算有限的購屋族，外擴到周遭縣市購屋置產進一步牽動人口數並形成區域房市發展的重要指標。房仲業者指出，近一年北北桃各行政區人口變化，以桃園市的大園區以2.9%的人口增幅居冠。
而淡水、觀音、龜山及林口區也都有1%以上的增幅，顯示新北與桃園的部分行政區，受到不少台北外溢族群的青睞。

統計數據顯示，觀察北、北、桃近一年人口增幅前五大行政區，桃園市就有大園、觀音及龜山3區入榜，顯示桃園市的部分區域，持續吸引雙北外溢人口移入。其中，人口增幅最明顯的大園區，永慶房屋研展中心副理陳金萍指出，該區受惠於桃園航空城的發展計畫，加上國2甲線通車與機捷A15、A16站的開發，大幅提升聯外交通的便利性。此外，受惠於客運園區相對親民房價與青埔商圈的外溢效應，因此吸引大量產業進駐與帶動居住人口移入，區域發展動能十足。

再來是房價最親民的觀音區及鄰近雙北的龜山區，陳金萍說明，觀音區近一年住宅平均總價763萬元，對預算有限的首購族及小家庭具有一定的吸引力。而且，隨著桃園整體都市發展逐步向外擴張，加上當地擁有產業園區就業支撐及相對充裕的新屋供給，較低的購屋門檻成為吸引人口進駐的重要條件。至於龜山區，鄰近雙北市，並具備機場捷運、國道及華亞科技園區等交通與產業優勢，對於希望兼顧通勤、生活機能及居住品質的購屋族而言，龜山區提供相對親民的總價，較容易承接外溢需求，加上區內住宅產品選擇多元，也有助於吸引年輕家庭及就業人口進駐。
新北市也有淡水、林口區入榜前五名，其中淡水區近一年人口增加3609人、年增1.7%，位居第二；林口區人口則增加1377人、年增1%，兩區人口均呈正成長。陳金萍分析，淡水區因距離台北市中心較遠，房價相對低廉，甚至比部分桃園地區實惠。對於荷包不深的青年首購、小資族群來說，相當有吸引力，且購屋負擔較輕。
而隨著淡海新市鎮的持續開發，結合淡海輕軌與區域建設到位，提升整體交通便利性與生活機能，帶動大量人口移入，也為當地房市提供穩定支撐與長期發展動能。
至於林口區，陳金萍指出，林口新市鎮經多年開發，近年隨機場捷運A9站通車、大型商場及商業機能逐步成熟，且具國道一號聯外交通優勢，已逐漸形成相對完整的居住生活圈；同時，AI智慧園區、科技產業及相關大型建設陸續進駐，也有助於增加就業機會與帶動人口移入。儘管林口區近一年平均總價已突破2千萬元大關，人口仍持續正成長，顯示該區在交通、商業機能及產業發展等條件逐步到位下，仍持續吸引家庭型買方。
paras_en: A dense transportation network has created a commuter life circle linking Taipei, New Taipei, and Taoyuan, and the high housing prices in the twin cities have pushed budget‑constrained homebuyers to expand outward into neighboring counties, further influencing population numbers and becoming a key indicator of regional housing market development. Real‑estate agents note that over the past year, population changes across the three regions show Taoyuan’s Dayuan District leading with a 2.9% increase.
Tamsui, Guanyin, Guishan and Linkou districts each posted growth of over 1%, indicating that certain districts in New Taipei and Taoyuan are popular among people moving out of Taipei.

Statistics of the top five districts with the highest population growth in the past year across the three regions show that Taoyuan contributes three entries – Dayuan, Guanyin and Guishan – underscoring the city’s continued draw for migrants from the twin cities. In Dayuan, where the growth is most pronounced, Chen Jin‑ping, deputy manager of the research centre at Yong‑qing Real Estate, points to the boost from the Taoyuan Aerotropolis project, the opening of National Highway 2A and the development of MRT A15 and A16 stations, all of which have dramatically improved external connectivity. In addition, relatively affordable housing in the bus‑terminal zone and the spill‑over effect of the Qingpu commercial hub have attracted many industries and spurred residential inflow, giving the area strong development momentum.

Next are the most affordable Guanyin District and the nearby Guishan District, which borders the twin cities. Chen explains that the average total price of a residential unit in Guanyin over the past year was NT$7.63 million, appealing to first‑time buyers and small families with limited budgets. As Taoyuan’s overall urban expansion pushes outward, the district’s industrial parks provide employment support and a plentiful supply of new homes, making the lower entry price a key draw for newcomers. Guishan, close to Taipei and New Taipei, benefits from MRT Airport Line access, highways and the Huaya Technology Park, offering a balance of commuting convenience, lifestyle amenities and living quality. Its relatively modest total prices and diverse housing options make it easier to absorb spill‑over demand, attracting young families and workers.

New Taipei also sees Tamsui and Linkou among the top five. Tamsui’s population grew by 3,609 people, a 1.7% annual rise, ranking second, while Linkou added 1,377 residents, a 1% increase; both districts posted positive growth. Chen notes that Tamsui’s greater distance from central Taipei translates into lower housing prices, even cheaper than some areas of Taoyuan, which is attractive to cash‑strapped young first‑time buyers and entry‑level earners, easing the home‑buying burden.

With the ongoing development of the Danhai New Town, the integration of Danhai Light Rail and completed regional infrastructure have improved overall transport convenience and livability, drawing a large influx of residents and providing stable support and long‑term momentum for the local housing market.

As for Linkou, Chen points out that after years of development, the new town has recently benefited from the opening of MRT Airport Line A9 station, the maturation of large malls and commercial functions, and its advantage of direct access to National Highway 1, gradually forming a relatively complete residential‑life circle. Meanwhile, the arrival of AI smart parks, technology industries and other major projects is creating jobs and attracting more people. Although the average total price in Linkou has just surpassed NT$20 million in the past year, the population continues to grow, showing that under improving transport, commercial and industrial conditions, the area still draws family‑type buyers.

With Moore’s Law slowing, massive expansion of advanced packaging has become the only solution. As process difficulty doubles, key equipment focused on heat dissipation and warpage prevention is entering a golden growth phase, with values doubling and sites multiplying rapidly.
Chip Size and Power Surge, CoPoS and SoIC Lead Innovation

Next‑generation chips are getting larger, their TDP is multiplying by generations, and 3D vertical stacking shortens interconnect distances. To overcome the 45% wafer‑area utilization limit of large dies, TSMC is pushing a square‑panel carrier called CoPoS, slated for volume production in 2028, which will raise area efficiency to 81%. As package area expands, layer counts rise and the CTE mismatch among heterogeneous materials widens, warpage during heating worsens non‑linearly. Anti‑warpage treatment becomes a mass‑production necessity. Single‑chip power exceeds 1,500‑2,000 W, forcing heat‑removal solutions inside the chip and spurring explosive demand for lid/stiffener and TIM bonding equipment. Vendors are not only scaling shipments as cleaning, baking and inspection stations multiply, but also boosting average selling prices and per‑unit capacity value through integrated multifunctional solutions.
